_use_cases: Smoke testing local development servers before a deployment
Exploratory UI testing: 'Does this page load and show the right elements?'
Taking screenshots of app states for bug reports
Checking for browser console errors across multiple pages
_safety_rules: Only run against localhost or an explicit staging URL — never production.
Puppeteer can submit forms and click buttons. A misunderstood prompt can trigger side effects.
Puppeteer has access to all URLs reachable from the machine running Claude, including internal network addresses.
If your machine has access to internal admin panels or infrastructure UIs (Kubernetes dashboard, Grafana, etc.), those are reachable by this MCP server.
Scope firewall rules to block the MCP process from reaching sensitive internal services if necessary.

puppeteer._comment: Headless Chromium browser controlled by Claude. No credentials required — access is based on network reachability.
puppeteer._when_to_use: Local and staging smoke tests, UI verification, screenshot capture. Not a replacement for automated Playwright/Cypress suites.
